messages:
Tara (marketing): Heads-up: saw ~20 HS leads land with no owner since 14:12 UTC. `enriched` flag missing on first delivery. Can revops/ops triage?
Ibrahim (revops): Checking HS webhook logs  enrichment endpoint returning intermittent 502s on batched payloads. Our RR lambda currently checks enrichment synchronously and gives up after 2m.
Jess (ops): Quick mitigation: 1) temporary router rule to send leads without `enriched=true` into `rr-fallback` pool; 2) set feature-flag `lead.claim_window` 120->360s (canary 5% -> 100%); 3) tag routed leads with `routed_via=fallback_enrich` and `enrich_incident=3627774444`. Thumbs?
Cal (sales): Thumbs. Please add visible HS timeline note "Fallback routed due to enrichment delay" so reps don't duplicate outreach.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-api /bulk-enrich 5xx increased 0.3% -> 9.1% (14:05 - 14:18 UTC). Auto-backoff triggered.
Ibrahim (revops): I'll create cohort tag `enrich-delay-3627774444` and add dashboard panels for `time_to_owner` and `first_touch_conversion`. Set an alert if avg time_to_owner > 6m.
Jess (ops): Canary started 14:25 UTC. URL: https://grafana.redwood/d/leadflow/routing?panel=2
Tara (marketing): I'll pause webinar follow-ups that rely on enrichment tags and draft a one-paragraph FYI for #sales-ops.
Jess (ops): Canary healthy at 14:31 UTC, increasing to 50%. Enrich 5xx rate trending down to 2.0%.
Ibrahim (revops): Incident INC-2026-8890 opened. Postmortem action items: make enrich callbacks idempotent, reevaluate default claim_window (proposal: 300s), and harden HubSpot retry behavior. I'll consolidate.
Cal (sales): When you flip the router, please include header `X-Routed-Via: fallback_enrich` on downstream webhooks. Makes filtering easier.
Jess (ops): Will add header and a short sampling log for 0.5% of fallback leads to capture raw payloads. Rolling to 100% now.
Tara (marketing): Sent comms to #sales-ops and paused webinar sequences. Keep updates in this thread.
